mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_releases(version, file_name, stored_file_name, sha256, file_size, mandatory, patch_base_version, patch_file_name, patch_stored_file_name, patch_sha256, patch_file_size, release_note, created_by) VALUES(#{version}, #{fileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{sha256}, #{fileSize}, #{mandatory}, #{patchBaseVersion}, #{patchFileName}, #{patchStoredFileName}, #{patchSha256}, #{patchFileSize}, #{releaseNote}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_releases SET patch_base_version = #{patchBaseVersion}, patch_file_name = #{patchFileName}, patch_stored_file_name = #{patchStoredFileName}, patch_sha256 = #{patchSha256}, patch_file_size = #{patchFileSize} WHERE version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_release_patches(release_id, base_version, file_name, stored_file_name, sha256, file_size) VALUES(#{releaseId}, #{baseVersion}, #{fileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{sha256}, #{fileSize}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_name = VALUES(file_name), stored_file_name = VALUES(stored_file_name), sha256 = VALUES(sha256), file_size = VALUES(file_size)
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.release_id, p.base_version, p.file_name, p.stored_file_name, p.sha256, p.file_size, p.created_at FROM app_release_patches p WHERE p.release_id = #{releaseId} ORDER BY p.base_version

SELECT r.id, r.version, r.file_name, r.stored_file_name, r.sha256, r.file_size, r.mandatory, r.patch_base_version, r.patch_file_name, r.patch_stored_file_name, r.patch_sha256, r.patch_file_size, r.release_note, r.active, r.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM app_releases r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.created_by ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.version, r.file_name, r.stored_file_name, r.sha256, r.file_size, r.mandatory, r.patch_base_version, r.patch_file_name, r.patch_stored_file_name, r.patch_sha256, r.patch_file_size, r.release_note, r.active, r.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM app_releases r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.created_by WHERE r.active = TRUE ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.version, r.file_name, r.stored_file_name, r.sha256, r.file_size, r.mandatory, r.patch_base_version, r.patch_file_name, r.patch_stored_file_name, r.patch_sha256, r.patch_file_size, r.release_note, r.active, r.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM app_releases r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.created_by WHERE r.version = #{version}

SELECT r.id, r.version, r.file_name, r.stored_file_name, r.sha256, r.file_size, r.mandatory, r.patch_base_version, r.patch_file_name, r.patch_stored_file_name, r.patch_sha256, r.patch_file_size, r.release_note, r.active, r.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM app_releases r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.created_by WHERE r.id = #{id}
